method_identity.adapter_scope: owned dataset-specific frozen plants with native and inserted transport dispatch

data_roles.name: D_fit
data_roles.allocation: 60% of official training, with internal fit_train/fit_val partition

data_roles.name: D_explore
data_roles.use: logged trajectories; observer, critic, sequence-model fitting and empirical calibration

data_roles.name: D_select
data_roles.use: nested comparator reconstruction and finite-family selection

data_roles.name: D_confirm
data_roles.use: frozen confirmation contrasts; eligible downgrades only

data_roles.name: D_admit
data_roles.use: one fixed policy versus one fixed comparator

data_roles.name: D_test
data_roles.use: final reporting after deployment is sealed; no subsequent decisions

provenance.scope: workflow integrity and accidental-mutation detection; no authenticated external trust anchor

inference_scope.independent_graph_datasets: equal-graph risk; conditional clipped empirical-Bernstein admission under the stated independence assumptions
inference_scope.Roman-empire_campaign: ten official masks; descriptive split-level paired Student-t summary; no independence of overlapping graph masks asserted

fallback_contract: registered internal recovery remains allowed; unrecoverable runtime failure and rejected global admission use the frozen comparator branch
reproduction_claim: Numerical and checkpoint replay of completed runs; manuscript comparisons require explicit artifact bindings.

calibration.group: complete graph across all seeds/trajectories for graph datasets; seed_index/trajectory for a single graph

headroom: one complete evaluated global candidate; per-core optimistic mixture is diagnostic only
input_gate: exact prepared graph collection/schema; novel-input service routing is not implemented
nonlinear_metrics: Recompute macro F1, ROC-AUC and AP on paired observations in every whole-unit resample, including reconstructed comparators.
